text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each arm minus B0 on the quantile score, by the CAMS clear-sky index at the valid time, by season, and by lead band; below zero favours the arm. 16 Primary substations; 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months and seeds.'
text.tspan: Each arm minus B0 on the quantile score, by the CAMS clear-sky index at the valid time, by

runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026.
Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months and seeds.
